headline: Norton Launches Safe AI Following Surge in Malicious Chatbot Content
summary: Norton launched Safe AI to block unauthorized actions by artificial intelligence assistants, addressing a reported 54% increase in malicious content delivered via chatbots.
why: Cybersecurity firms develop specialized software to counter rising enterprise and consumer risks associated with generative artificial intelligence adoption.

impacts.name: Cybersecurity
impacts.why: Rising threats related to AI-driven malicious content drive commercial demand for specialized security software solutions.
